Huh?
Wait a minute.
Is this a dead end?
I-I can’t find a corridor that would lead me further! Fuck!
AbusedTenant: Richard I think I’m at a dead end, I can’t get to you from where I am
Little_Richard: What?! I checked the shortest route, did you turn right or went through the tunnel?
AbusedTenant: I went through the tunnel
AbusedTenant: Is that bad?
Little_Richard: Quickly! Turn around and go the other way! DAK could come to you any time!
